column1: # microG prebuilts built into the Q25 image (SABLE_Q25_MICROG=YES, Q4 and later; off by default).
# The add-on APKs that are never built in (GsfProxy, Aurora Store) are pinned in addon.tsv.
# No APK is tracked in git. scripts/fetch-microg.sh downloads each row's url into
# SABLE_MICROG_CACHE (default $SABLE_BUILD_ROOT/microg-cache) and refuses any file whose
# sha256 differs; scripts/stage-product.sh checks the hashes again before it stages them.
# The APKs are installed exactly as their developers signed them (presigned): LineageOS
# lets only the microG release key spoof Google's signature, so they must not be re-signed.
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   module        Soong module name (product/q25/microg/Android.bp)
#   package       application id
#   version       versionName (versionCode)
#   sha256        sha256 of the APK
#   url           official download
# Sources and how the hashes were taken (2026-11-12):
#   GmsCore, FakeStore: microG release v0.3.18.252432 (tag commit f686900c68aa84d1605b52304f6615f3593c6f50),
#     https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/releases/tag/v0.3.18.252432. sha256 of the downloaded release
#     assets; both are signed with the microG release key (certificate SHA-256 9bd06727...d14165, the
#     same key as v0.3.17), and GmsCore requests the same permissions as v0.3.17. 0.3.18 wraps the
#     account prompts it returns in its exported UnpackingRedirectActivity, so Aurora Store's Google
#     login (overrideCertificate) can open the "allow Aurora" prompt; on 0.3.17 Android refused to
#     start the non-exported AskPackageOverrideActivity and Aurora waited forever.
#     "FakeStore" is the microG Companion (com.android.vending), built from the same repo.
#     GsfProxy is not built in: it is only for pre-2016 C2DM apps and GmsCore handles
#     Google Services Framework itself. The add-on can install it (addon.tsv).
# To update: change version, url and sha256 in one reviewed commit, then
#   NETWORK_FETCH_AUTHORIZED=YES bash scripts/fetch-microg.sh
module
GmsCore
FakeStore
